releaseNotes: v3.7.0: Image loading pipeline overhaul — Coil EventListener now surfaces all load failures to Logcat for instant diagnosis. PosterCard and ChannelCard show a dark gray fallback box on error instead of rendering invisible. Cleartext traffic confirmed enabled for HTTP IPTV image servers. MemoryBudgetManager verified: image cache floor at 16 MB (never 0). 720p downsampling interceptor confirmed chain-safe.
